reading.body:
EdgeCore Ashburn AS02 is a 114 MW IT capacity campus in Sterling, Virginia. This translates, at the common assumption of 400 watts per rack for AI training workloads, to roughly 285 racks of accelerator-dense compute, or at 8 GPUs per rack to approximately 2,280 high-end accelerators. The facility spans 685,000 square feet and holds LEED certification, qualifying it for environmentally managed operations.

In Virginia's published data center landscape, this campus ranks third by IT capacity among the 25 facilities with published megawatt figures. Virginia's 330 mapped data centers total 1,603 MW of published capacity, meaning EdgeCore Ashburn AS02 represents 7.1 percent of the state's disclosed IT load. The vast majority of Virginia's mapped facilities do not publish capacity figures, so true state capacity is substantially larger than the published total.

The site's 114 MW positions it as material infrastructure for AI model training or serving at scale, though smaller than the largest US campuses. Its location in Ashburn, the data center core of Northern Virginia, places it within the region's existing power and network backbone. Grid constraints on further expansion in Virginia are not published here and remain unknown.
